acquirer.name: Eaton Vance Limited Duration Income Fund

announcement.quote: Recourse for liabilities assumed from EOE by EVV in the Reorganization will be limited to the assets acquired by EVV.

deals.notes: Reorganization of Eaton Vance Credit Opportunities Fund (EOE) into Eaton Vance Limited Duration Income Fund (EVV), with EVV common shares and cash consideration. The agreement conditions the closing on the NYSE Amex approving the listing of additional EVV shares, which shows EVV is exchange-listed but the excerpts say nothing on EOE's listing. The later DEF 14As (trustee elections, Feb 2010 and Feb 2011) do not mention the merger, so no filing in the window states the outcome.
